name: VIMA
description: VIMA is a simulation benchmark for robot manipulation tasks specified by multimodal prompts combining textual and visual tokens. It includes thousands of procedurally-generated tabletop tasks, over 600K expert trajectories, and a four-level evaluation protocol for systematic generalization.
reputation: A well-known multimodal robot manipulation benchmark that is frequently cited for systematic generalization and large-scale simulated demonstrations.
notes: Includes a large-scale dataset and evaluation protocol; focuses on general robot manipulation with multimodal prompts.
